parent_objective: implement bounded fusion_head split-repeat source-history diagnostic
blocked_by: M1301 designs split-repeat robustness but no repeat artifacts exist
supersedes: single split M1299 result as robustness evidence

public_gates: M1302 must preserve actor input contract
M1302 must not use private holdout
M1302 must run multiple pair-disjoint split offsets
M1302 must report repeat pass counts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train scopes beyond fusion_head
do not treat repeat success as closed-loop proof

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests M1299 fusion_head result across deterministic pair-disjoint split offsets
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if any forbidden parameter group mutates
stop if repeat summaries are missing
stop if implementation requires actor-input expansion
fallback_plan: if repeat strong, route to result audit and proof-retention design
if repeat mixed, route to result audit and scope/corpus decision
if repeat negative, route to corpus refresh or sequence preference design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: fifth milestone in trainable-scope escalation branch

admission_evidence: M1301 defines split offsets and repeat thresholds
M1299 fusion_head was strong on one split
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1302 uses fixed-current intervention observations and source-history hidden states; it does not prove closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: correct-history versus wrong-history metrics must be repeated across split offsets
pair-disjoint split variants must be reported
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1280 source-history prefixes with fixed M1277 intervention observations.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repeat is mixed or negative, keep PPO blocked and route to audit/corpus refresh.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1299 fusion_head signal remains positive across multiple deterministic pair-disjoint split offsets.
success_criteria: repeat summaries and offset pass counts are reported
forbidden parameter mutation flag is false
result class is repeat strong, mixed, negative, or contract artifact
no PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: thresholds are relaxed after seeing results

commands.name: run_probe
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.source_history_trainable_scope_probe --checkpoint runs/m1154_row15_promoted_unsafe_margin_projection_probe/checkpoints/alpha_0_05.pt --history-run-dir runs/m1280_four_wheel_source_response_history_materialization --intervention-run-dir runs/m1277_four_wheel_source_intervention_materialization --run-dir runs/m1302_source_history_trainable_scope_repeat_probe --device cpu --steps 400 --lr 0.0002 --target-margin 0.05 --scopes fusion_head --split-offsets 0,1,2,3,4

decision_rule: M1302 passes as diagnostic infrastructure if it reports split-repeat results without forbidden mutations and routes to audit.
